snippet.title: Squeeze the bubbles! Indie game promo.
snippet.description:
Check out《Squeeze》On Steam!! 
If you like , please add to Wishlist!!

ABOUT THE GAME:
Spin, jet, control bubbles to rescue little animals.
* A casual puzzle game - unwind here and relieve your stress!
* Silky water flow, bouncy bubbles, exhilarating to play however you want!
* Straightforward mechanics: Splitting, Bubble Machines, Gravity, Heating, Water Pipes...
* Minimalist yet magical art style.
* A one-of-a-kind novel experience.
